text:
noor: Release blocked for sdk-python after a typegen regen. Publish failed with 401 and our semver-check flagged a breaking diff. Opening thread to triage.

noor: ```
$ ./scripts/release-sdk.py python
> typegen: regenerated clients (openapi v2.1.0) -> changed order of generated imports + renamed _internal_helper -> _helper_v2
> build wheel -> ok
> twine upload dist/*
HTTPError: 401 Unauthorized
Release aborted: semver-check detected non-trivial diff; missing changelog fragment for minor bump
```

ci-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=7810 failed (step=publish): reason="401 + semver-guard" :robot_face:

dan: is the rename internal-only? semver tool uses file diffs so any change in generated files can trigger guard.

noor: the rename is internal, and the import reorder is nondeterministic across runs. Consumers shouldn't see API change, but our dist diff flags it.

ivy: short-term unblock: add a changelog fragment noting the non-breaking regen noise and re-run. Long-term: we should canonicalize typegen outputs (stable import order + strip private renames) before diffing. filing ticket DX-887.

chris: the 401 looks like the pypi token expired mid-upload; CI runner didn't refresh creds on retry. Publish step does 2 retries with no token refresh. We should add exponential backoff + token refresh hook.

dan: can someone re-run with a fresh token after adding the fragment? I can approve the quick patch for retry afterwards.

noor: added scripts/changelog/fragments/sdk-python-regen-noise.md and retriggered job #7811.

ci-bot: job #7811 queued by noor.

chris: opened PR https://git.internal/pr/7010 to change publish action to use retryUtil.backoff(max=5, baseMs=400, jitter=true) and call creds.fetch() before each retry. Assigning to dan for review.

dan: reviewing now, small nit about fetch timeout. will approve after tweak.

ci-bot: job #7811 started -> publish step invoked

noor: publish hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but retry+refresh succeeded; semver fragment satisfied the guard. package uploaded as redwood_inference_sdk_python-0.8.0.tar.gz.

ivy: smoke tests passed for sampleapp onboarding. I'll add a gating e2e that simulates token expiry to prevent regressions (DX-888).

dan: merging PR #7010 after the minor timeout tweak. Also creating RFC DX-RFC-12 for a typegen-normalizer to canonicalize outputs before semver diff. @ivy please review.

noor: closing loop: job #7811 succeeded, PR #7010 merged, DX-887/DX-888/DX-RFC-12 filed. Thanks all.

ci-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=7811 succeeded :tada:
